properties.notes: 5-15 House Supply. Demolition and redevelopment behind retained street facades at 54 and 55-57 Great Marlborough Street to provide a new building comprising basement, ground and first to seventh floor levels. Use of the part basement and ground floor levels as two retail units (Class A1) and one dual/alternative retail or restaurant (Class A1/A3) unit at part basement and ground floor levels. Use of part basement and ground and the entire first to seventh floor levels as residential accommodation comprising 27 units with associated terraces at rear first floor and balconies at fifth and sixth floor levels. Excavation at basement level, the provision of a green roof at main roof level and installation of plant in the basement and at seventh floor level. (Site includes 54 Great Marlborough Street). http://idoxpa.westminster.gov.uk/online-applications/applicationDetails.do?activeTab=summary&keyVal=NN44LFRPFGG00
